quotes.quote: The results of the FCM showed the absence of cell surface CD18 expression without and with stimulation, which strongly suggested a presumptive diagnosis of LAD1 (Supplementary Fig. S4).

in_trans.statement: Patient 13 is listed with two ITGB2 variants (c.533C>T p.Pro178Leu and c.82_95del14), which suggests compound heterozygosity, but zygosity and phase are not stated and no parental testing is reported.

functional.statement: Patient-cell flow cytometry only: CD18/CD11 0.0% in patient 13 vs 100.0% in a healthy control; absent surface CD18 with and without stimulation reported for the three LAD patients.

The results of the FCM showed the absence of cell surface CD18 expression without and with stimulation, which strongly suggested a presumptive diagnosis of LAD1 (Supplementary Fig. S4).

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Frameshift 14-bp deletion, p.(Phe28LeufsTer26) (batch HGVS c.82_95del); paper writes c.82_95del14, p.Phe28Leufs*26. The Discussion refers to loss-of-function ITGB2 mutations in LAD-1 generally.

quotes.quote: Likewise, PIDs caused by the LOF genetic mutation of the ITGB2 gene in LAD-1, the PRF gene in FLH2, and the STAT3 gene in AD-HIES showed absence or a marked decrease of the corresponding proteins or related functional proteins.

concerns: Patient 13 is printed on two Table 4 rows with identical sex, age and CD18 values, one per variant (c.533C>T p.Pro178Leu; c.82_95del14). Zygosity and phase are not stated; the two rows could also reflect a table-layout artifact in the converted text, so the panel should check the original table.
Patient 12 (female, 2 years) carries c.533C>T only (as printed); the paper does not say whether patients 12 and 13 are related.
Clinical features are cohort-level for the three LAD patients; no per-person phenotype beyond absent CD18/CD11.
Transcript not stated; the HGVS form 'c.82_95del14' (with a length suffix) corresponds to the batch's c.82_95del; the predicted protein agrees.
The 'AR' column is the mode of inheritance, not a statement about this patient's genotype.
notes_for_panel: A flow-cytometry cohort paper from Korea; the variant appears only in Table 4 for patient 13, with a second ITGB2 variant c.533C>T (p.Pro178Leu) on an adjacent row. No case description, no family data.
